scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.dev:main: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && electron dist/main/index.js --inspect=5858
scripts.package:linux: pnpm --filter @mugiwara-manga/web build && npm run build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @mugiwara-manga/web build && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:win: pnpm --filter @mugiwara-manga/web build && npm run build && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:all: pnpm --filter @mugiwara-manga/web build && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --win --mac
